title: pyrus heterophylla
intro: Pyrus heterophylla, commonly known as the Japanese mountain pear, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to East Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus heterophylla are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and anti-arrhythmic effects, which help to protect against cardiovascular disease and reduce the risk of stroke. The bioactive constituents of Pyrus heterophylla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
